name: com.ivssuk/instant-pricing
title: IVSS Instant pricing
description: Vehicle shipping guide prices by route, and an exact IVSS quotation once the user confirms.

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: Use this when the user asks where IVSS (International Vehicle Shipping Services, UK; member of BIFA and FIATA) ships vehicles. Returns the routes that have published guide prices. No prices.

tools.name: get_indicative_price
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to know roughly what it costs to ship a car, 4x4, van, motorhome, camper or overland vehicle internationally by RORO. Returns IVSS guide prices (typical RORO sea freight from IVSS quotes in the last 90 days) for matching routes, with the route page, and container prices per container (20ft, 40ft high cube, shared) where IVSS has a container tariff for the lane. Guide prices are not a quote: for an exact price use request_exact_quote.

from.description: Country or region the vehicle ships from, e.g. "UK", "Europe", "USA"

to.description: Country or region the vehicle ships to, e.g. "Australia", "Canada"

vehicle.description: Optional: car, 4x4, van, motorhome, camper, truck

tools.name: request_exact_quote
tools.description: Use this when the user wants an exact price to ship their vehicle internationally. Ask the user for every required detail, including THEIR OWN email address; never invent one. For cars and 4x4s also ask for the make and model and the year. The price is not returned in this chat: IVSS emails the user a link, and the exact price with sailings is shown when they open it. Only call this after the user has agreed to IVSS handling their details to prepare the price (privacy policy: https://ivssuk.com/privacy-policy/).

from_country.description: Country shipping from, English name, e.g. "United Kingdom"

to_country.description: Country shipping to, English name, e.g. "Australia"

to_port.description: Optional. The discharge port, when the user names one. Australia only for now: Melbourne, Fremantle, Port Kembla, Sydney or Brisbane (name or UN/LOCODE, e.g. AUMEL). Pass it whenever the user names a port; leave it out to price every Australian port and keep the cheapest.

ship_date.description: When the user wants to ship, YYYY-MM-DD

personal_effects.description: True if belongings will be packed inside the vehicle

user_agreed_privacy.description: True only if the user agreed to IVSS handling their details to prepare the price

tools.name: request_trip_quote
tools.description: Use this when the user plans to ship the same vehicle on several legs of one trip, for example an overland or round-the-world trip (UK to South Africa, then South Africa to Australia). Ask for the vehicle details once and for each leg: from, to and when. Ask the user for THEIR OWN email address; never invent one. IVSS sends ONE email with a link per leg; each link opens the exact price for that leg, with sailings and how to book. Prices are never returned here. For one shipment use request_exact_quote. Use get_indicative_price first if the user only wants rough costs.

legs.description: The shipments in trip order, 2 to 6

to_port.description: Optional. The discharge port, when the user names one. Australia only for now: Melbourne, Fremantle, Port Kembla, Sydney or Brisbane (name or UN/LOCODE, e.g. AUMEL). Pass it whenever the user names a port; leave it out to price every Australian port and keep the cheapest.

ship_date.description: When this leg should ship, YYYY-MM-DD

reason.description: Only if this leg differs from the trip reason, e.g. "Returning to country of origin" for the last leg
Usually "Temporary Import" for an overland trip

personal_effects.description: True if belongings will be packed inside the vehicle

user_agreed_privacy.description: True only if the user agreed to IVSS handling their details to prepare the prices

tools.name: get_sailings
tools.description: Use this when the user asks when the next ship leaves for a route, or which sailings there are in a month. Returns upcoming sailings (vessel, port of loading, port of discharge, departure and arrival dates, RORO or container) from the IVSS sailing schedule, with the time the schedule was last verified. Dates are subject to confirmation at booking; if the schedule data is out of date the tool says so and gives no dates.

from.description: Where the vehicle ships from: a country (e.g. "UK", "Germany", "USA"), a region (europe, north-america, south-america, oceania ...) or a port code (e.g. GBSOU)

to.description: Where it ships to: country, region or port code, e.g. "Canada", "south-america", "AUMEL"

month.description: Optional, YYYY-MM within the next 12 months

tools.name: get_price_by_dimensions
tools.description: Use this when the user gives the route and their vehicle (type and, for anything bigger than a car, its length, width and height) and wants an indicative price. Returns a rounded price range from the IVSS pricing engine (the same one as Instant pricing): sea freight, export handling and destination port costs, before import duty and taxes. Not a quote, no email, nothing is stored. For the exact itemised price use Instant pricing or request_exact_quote.

from_country.description: Country the vehicle ships from, e.g. "United Kingdom", "Germany"

to_country.description: Country it ships to, e.g. "United States", "Australia"

length_m.description: Overall length in metres (optional for a car or 4x4)

width_m.description: Overall width in metres, including mirrors

height_m.description: Overall height in metres, including roof racks

tools.name: get_confirmed_quote
tools.description: After request_exact_quote, IVSS emails the user a confirm link and gives you a fetch_id. Once the user has clicked that link, call this with the fetch_id to show the itemised exact price (sea freight and export costs, destination costs) in the chat. Before the user confirms it returns nothing but a reminder to click the link.
